title: Lido Multichain Deployment Ledger
description: Schema for a ledger whose record unit is one deployed contract address on one concrete blockchain network.

$schema.description: Relative or absolute reference to the JSON Schema governing this ledger document.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the ledger data model, independent of the JSON Schema specification version.

updatedAt.description: Calendar date on which this ledger snapshot was last updated.

coverage.description: Optional notes describing what this snapshot intentionally covers. Absence does not prove completeness.

notes.description: Human-readable coverage statement for this snapshot.

knownGaps.description: Optional list of known absences or unverified areas. Entries here are acknowledgements, not exhaustive.

networks.description: Concrete networks referenced by deployments, keyed by networkId. Network metadata lives here so it cannot diverge across entries.

deployments.description: Flat array of deployment entries (not keyed by deploymentId). Identity uniqueness and cross-entry references are enforced by validate_ledger.py so each address stays independently ordered and addressable without nesting.

networkId.description: CAIP-2-shaped network identifier consisting of a namespace and a namespace-specific reference.

deploymentId.description: CAIP-10-shaped identifier combining a concrete network identifier and a network-native address.

networkEntry.description: Metadata for one concrete network identified by its map key (networkId).

networkName.description: Human-readable canonical name for the concrete network.

chainFamily.description: Broader blockchain or rollup technology family that groups related networks (for example op-stack, not one value per chain).

environment.description: Operational classification of the concrete network, distinct from network identity.

source.description: Immutable or repository-relative provenance for the deployed contract's source code.

repositoryUrl.description: Repository containing the contract source code.

commit.description: Optional Git commit identifying the source revision.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to the source file or source directory.

proxy.description: Relationships from a proxy deployment to separately listed implementation and administration deployments.

proxyKind.description: Proxy upgrade/admin architecture. unknown means it was not established from the selected evidence.

implementationDeploymentId.description: deploymentId of the separately listed implementation address associated with this proxy.

adminDeploymentId.description: deploymentId of the separately listed proxy-admin address when one is documented.

beaconDeploymentId.description: deploymentId of the separately listed beacon address for a beacon proxy.

deploymentEntry.description: One current deployed contract address on one concrete network.

deploymentId.description: Stable identifier for one deployed address on one concrete network. For EVM deployments it is the CAIP-10-shaped combination of networkId and address.

contractId.description: Source-independent identifier for the protocol role fulfilled by the deployment. A proxy and its implementation share the same contractId when they jointly fulfill the same role. Unique source identity is expressed by source, not by this field. Historical or superseded role instances use an -archive suffix.

deploymentKind.description: Architectural kind of the deployed address (standalone means a non-proxy, non-implementation, non-admin, non-beacon, non-library address).

contractName.description: Solidity contract name of the bytecode deployed at this address (the compiler artifact / verified Contract Name), not a documentation prose label.

address.description: Network-native address of the deployed contract instance. EVM addresses preserve the spelling and checksum casing published by the source.

networkId.description: Globally scoped identity of the concrete network. Must be a key in the document-level networks map. EVM networks use the CAIP-2 eip155 namespace.

source.description: Contract source-code provenance when collected; null means no source repository has yet been established for this entry.

auditReportRefs.description: Pointers to audit-report carriers associated with the deployment or its code scope. Presence of a pointer does not establish bytecode equivalence or assurance.

publicRefs.description: Pointers to public official or near-official publication carriers (for example research.lido.fi forum posts, Snapshot/Aragon votes, or docs.lido.fi pages) that a reader can use to cross-check this deployment's address. Absence means none are recorded; presence does not establish correctness, completeness, DAO approval force, or assurance.
